'''"Smeeleeya Whao Tupee Upee" ''' was a popular [[Music/Legends|song]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Listen2|SmeeleeyaWhaoTupeeUpee.flac|"Smeeleeya Whao Tupee Upee"|A short sample clip}}
"Smeeleeya Whao Tupee Upee" is background music heard in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players can select it in [[Jukebox/Legends|jukeboxes]] using a jukebox token.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
